title.zh: 修订《修订行政法典》第1968条，将汇票可签发最高金额由美元改为菲律宾比索计值的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Nineteen Hundred Sixty-Eight of the Revised Administrative Code so as to Change in Terms of Pesos, Philippine Currency, Instead of Dollars, United States Currency, the Maximum Amount for Which a Money Order May be Issued
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Nineteen Hundred Sixty-Eight of the Revised Administrative Code so as to Change in Terms of Pesos, Philippine Currency, Instead of Dollars, United States Currency, the Maximum Amount for Which a Money Order May be Issued

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_119_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section nineteen hundred and sixty-eight of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1968. Maximum amount payable by money order. — No money order shall be issued for a greater sum than two hundred pesos Philippine currency; and unless specifically authorized by the Director of Posts, no postmaster shall directly or indirectly sell more than ten money orders in one day to one party payable to the same person."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 7, 1947
